metadata.name: Terminal colors
m8e77608957f9: Each SSH connection can choose its own theme. Deleting a custom theme makes connections using it fall back to the default.
m695a78c111e1: Create a theme based on the current one to customize every color.

metadata.description: Manages default and custom color schemes and connection-level choices for all SSH terminals. Colors update without reconnecting.
connection.hint: Colors are saved per connection entry and update all its terminals. Each SSH can use a different scheme. Saving preserves the connection and output.
connection.offline: Reconnect to the service or unlock it before saving colors.
connection.missing: This connection entry no longer exists. Close this panel and select another connection.
connection.conflict: This connection’s colors were changed in another page. Close and reopen this panel.
connection.saved: Saved to this connection. Terminal colors have been updated.
